# AP Engineering Tools

> Precision engineering reference tools for oil and gas — API 6A flange dimensions, tubing block safe working load calculations, and printable dimension tables. Built for field and office use at tools.anjanpatel.ca.

## Tools

- [Flange Slide Rule](https://tools.anjanpatel.ca/flange/): Interactive API 6A / ISO 10423 flange dimensional lookup — bore, OD, raised-face diameter, bolt circle, stud count, stud diameter, stud length, and ring gasket series for pressure classes 2,000 through 15,000 psi. Supports inch and metric (mm) display. Exportable as PDF.
- [Tubing Block SWL](https://tools.anjanpatel.ca/tubing/): Safe working load calculator for tubing blocks — enter block capacity, number of lines, and safety factor to get SWL in tons. Shows each calculation step.


## About

- [Home](https://tools.anjanpatel.ca/): Hub listing all tools

## FAQ

### What pressure classes does this cover?
The Flange Slide Rule covers API 6A pressure classes 2,000, 3,000, 5,000, 10,000, and 15,000 psi (also written 2K, 3K, 5K, 10K, 15K).

### What bore sizes are included?
The Flange Slide Rule includes nominal bore sizes: 2-1/16, 2-9/16, 3-1/8, 4-1/16, 5-1/8, 7-1/16, 9, 11, 13-5/8, and 16-3/4 inches.

### What is SWL?
SWL stands for Safe Working Load — the maximum load a lifting device is rated to carry under defined conditions. The Tubing Block SWL calculator divides the block's rated capacity by the number of lines and the safety factor to give SWL in tons, showing each step of the calculation.

### What standards do these tools reference?
The flange tools reference API 6A / ISO 10423, the specification for wellhead and christmas tree equipment used in oil and gas production.

### Can I export or print the results?
Yes. Every tool page has an Export PDF button. The Flange Slide Rule generates a formatted single-page landscape PDF. The Tubing Block SWL tool exports the full calculation breakdown.

### Is there a mobile or offline version?
The site is a Progressive Web App (PWA). Add it to your home screen from Safari or Chrome and it works offline using cached data. All tools function without an internet connection after the first load.
